changes.value: Light page with white and very pale blue-grey surfaces; rounded cards (16px) with a soft shadow; pill-shaped buttons, filled green for the main action and white with a navy outline for the second; headlines in navy with blue and green emphasis words; small spaced-out capital eyebrow labels; deep navy banners (#00346e and #002b61) with the photo on the right; deep navy footer (#001b38). The main button green is #2b7d32 with white text (5.1:1), because the mockup's bright green #3fa80c fails contrast with white text (3.1:1). Blue #006cbc is for links and small accents. The logo's bright green is for icons and highlights only. Dark theme stays.

Build the pages the navigation points to as structure with clearly labelled mock text: Categories (all categories), For Businesses (how quotes work, audience cards, a Request a quote button that is switched off until the quote flow is built), About, and Contact (details plus a WhatsApp link; no form yet). Footer links to FAQ, Shipping and Delivery, Returns and Refunds, Payment Methods, Track Order, Privacy Policy and Terms appear only when the page has real content. Social icons appear only with real links. The address, phone, email and opening hours in the mockup are treated as mock until supplied.

The trust row and the Why Choose section make promises: fast delivery across Ghana, quality brands, great value, dedicated support and secure payments. Shown as mock copy until the owner confirms each is true. Secure payments is shown only once Paystack live payments are approved.
